category.name: Databases, vector stores and memory
category.description: Managed SQL/NoSQL databases, vector search and long-term memory layers for agents.

entries.name: Chroma Cloud
entries.free_tier: freemium: ~1M embeddings plus free credits, no card for signup
entries.desc_en: Create databases and store/query vector embeddings for retrieval via REST/SDK or MCP server.

entries.name: ClickHouse Cloud
entries.auth_hint: Basic auth with Cloud API key id/secret
entries.free_tier: no permanent free tier; 30-day trial with $300 credits
entries.desc_en: Run SQL analytics queries and manage Cloud services/backups via REST API or official MCP server.
entries.notes: Cloud-hosted remote MCP adds service management, billing, and ClickPipe visibility.

entries.name: Convex
entries.free_tier: generous free tier for small apps, zero cost/maintenance
entries.desc_en: Introspect tables/functions, call functions, and read/write data in a reactive database via MCP or client SDKs.
entries.notes: Vector search available even on the free tier.

entries.name: Google BigQuery
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2/IAM (Google Cloud service account or user credentials)
entries.desc_en: Run SQL queries and inspect datasets/tables in BigQuery via REST API or the fully-managed remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Remote MCP server is hosted by Google, no local install needed.

entries.name: Letta
entries.free_tier: free personal tier with rotating free models; usage-based billing beyond that
entries.desc_en: Create and run stateful agents with persistent memory blocks via REST API or hosted MCP server.

entries.name: Mem0
entries.free_tier: free (Hobby) tier: 10K add requests, 1K retrievals/mo, 1 project
entries.desc_en: Add, search, update, and delete long-term agent memories via REST API or hosted MCP server.
entries.notes: Graph memory feature is gated to the Pro plan.

entries.name: MongoDB Atlas
entries.auth_hint: HTTP Digest auth with Atlas public/private API key, or OAuth2 service account
entries.free_tier: free tier: M0 cluster free forever (512MB)
entries.desc_en: Create/manage Atlas clusters and query MongoDB data via Admin API, drivers, or official MCP server.
entries.notes: MongoDB also offers a managed MCP server hosted by Atlas itself.

entries.name: Neon Postgres
entries.desc_en: Provision and manage serverless Postgres projects/branches and run SQL via REST API or MCP server.
entries.notes: OAuth recommended for local IDEs, static API key for headless agents.

entries.name: Pinecone
entries.desc_en: Upsert, query, and rerank vector embeddings in managed indexes via REST/SDK or MCP server.
entries.notes: Two official MCP servers: Developer/Assistant remote MCP and a local variant.

entries.name: PlanetScale
entries.desc_en: Manage MySQL databases, branches, and schema, and view Insights via hosted MCP server or API.
entries.notes: MCP server launched Jan 2026; configurable read-only vs full-access permissions.

entries.name: Qdrant Cloud
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1GB disk / 1 node cluster, no card; suspends after 1 week idle
entries.desc_en: Create clusters and store/search vector embeddings via REST/gRPC API, SDKs, or official MCP server.
entries.notes: Free clusters delete after 4 weeks of inactivity if not reactivated.

entries.name: Snowflake
entries.auth_hint: Key-pair auth, OAuth, or PAT; cloud_iam variants for Snowpark
entries.free_tier: trial credits (no permanent free tier); check pricing
entries.desc_en: Run SQL, Cortex Analyst, and Cortex Search over warehoused data via REST API or managed MCP server.
entries.notes: Snowflake-managed MCP server reached GA Nov 2025.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.auth_hint: apikey header + Authorization: Bearer <service_role or PAT>
entries.desc_en: Manage Postgres tables, auth, storage, and edge functions via REST/GraphQL APIs or client SDKs.
entries.notes: Official MCP server can also create/manage whole projects, not just query data.

entries.name: Turso
entries.free_tier: free tier: 100 databases, 500M row reads/mo, no card required
entries.desc_en: Create and query edge SQLite (libSQL) databases programmatically via HTTP/SDK client libraries.
entries.notes: No confirmed official MCP server found at verification time.

entries.name: Upstash (Redis, Vector)
entries.free_tier: free tier: Redis 256MB/500K cmds/mo; Vector 10K vectors
entries.desc_en: Call serverless Redis, Vector, and QStash over HTTP REST API from edge/serverless runtimes.
entries.notes: Remote MCP endpoint supports OAuth or API key.

entries.name: Weaviate Cloud
entries.free_tier: free 14-day Sandbox, ~50K objects, no card required (expires, not for persistence)
entries.desc_en: Store and semantically search vector objects in a managed cluster via REST/GraphQL or MCP server.
entries.notes: MCP endpoint built into the database at /v1/mcp, disabled by default.

entries.name: Zep
entries.desc_en: Store and retrieve temporal knowledge-graph agent memory via REST API or a single MCP endpoint.
entries.notes: One MCP URL serves both Zep managed cloud and BYOC deployments.

entries.name: Zilliz Cloud (Milvus)
entries.free_tier: free tier: serverless cluster, 5GB storage + $100 credits, no card
entries.desc_en: Manage Milvus clusters and perform vector search/ingestion via REST API, SDKs, or MCP server.
entries.notes: MCP server can even provision a new free-tier cluster on request.
